anonymous_const_write.c.rule: C17 6.5.16 paragraph 2 and 6.5.2.3 paragraphs 3-4 require a modifiable lvalue and preserve containing aggregate qualifiers. Cinder follows the physical anonymous member path and GCC rejects this const-member assignment. Clang accepts the exact reproducer; that reference diagnostic discrepancy remains separately recorded and does not waive the Cinder constraint.
